stories.headline: Bermuda Moves to Next Phase of On-Chain Economy Initiative
stories.body: Bermuda is accelerating its effort to make stablecoins a part of everyday commerce, Bermuda Premier David Burt said Wednesday (May 6). Speaking at CoinDesk’s Consensus Miami 2026, Burt said the country plans to do another airdrop of USDC stablecoin this year and to onboard merchants that can accept digital payments, CoinDesk reported Wednesday. stories.headline: Domino effect: How Iran war impacts farms, transport and banks
stories.body: As gas prices surge, small businesses — particularly in agriculture and transportation — have struggled to keep up. For banks, this has brought a combination of short-term benefits and long-term concerns.
